'''Pyry Nystrom''' (DeckTech handle '''Blizzard''')<ref name="dt-24274">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24274 Empire is virtually back], DeckTech (Pyry "Blizzard" Nystrom, 8 July 2002).
